ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily on the trailing edges and scar markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patches located along the posterior margin; numerous small circular high-intensity rings (rosettes) distributed across the dark field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree convergence angle, partially obscured by water turbulence at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; distal tips exhibit extreme high-amplitude irregularities due to dense barnacle colonization.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature observed on the leading edges tapering toward the distal tips; trailing edge follows a broken convex path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular white rings (rosettes) across both lobes, appearing as localized high-contrast clusters against the dark ventral skin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent horizontal linear white mark on the medial left lobe; several short, vertical linear disruptions on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations (barnacles) forming brownish-white textured masses on the far lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive white cross-shaped (plus sign) marking located on the medial section of the left lobe near the water line.
